designReferences.applied: Short equipment-led opening and concise copy.
Indexed sections, oversized typography, and a restrained industrial grid.
Generous image-led composition and alternating dark/light sections.
Equipment imagery as the main narrative, followed by a clear technology sequence.

implementation: Coastal-only layout and stylesheet; existing URLs retained. Other project layouts and content preserved.
Hero displays the full original assembly concept beside the title; no research image cropped by CSS.
Concept, method, assembly sequence, and AMERICA overview are visible without JavaScript or carousel controls.
Native slide artwork re-exported losslessly with source transparency resolved on white. Source presentation unchanged.
No company logos, videos, marketing claims, performance metrics, UF theme colors, or UF affiliation statements added.
Research scope identifies concept renderings and distinguishes the manufacturing reference from evidence of module fabrication.

validation.visualReview: Desktop hero, material images, complete overview, and 320px mobile reviewed in Chrome.
validation.textSpacing: 320px with 1.5 line-height, .12em letter-spacing, .16em word-spacing, and 2em paragraph spacing: no horizontal overflow.
validation.accessibility: Alt text, detailed figure descriptions, keyboard-operable full-size links, focus outlines, skip link, heading hierarchy, no-JavaScript content, and expanded source notes checked.

limitations: Automated checks do not establish full ADA/WCAG compliance; screen-reader usability across assistive technologies has not been fully evaluated.
External papers and publisher websites are outside the audit.
No coastal assembly footage or performance measurements were supplied; the page remains a concept presentation.
